import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 2000;
    static final int GRID = 12;
    static final int INF = (int)1e9;

    static int[][] dist = new int[GRID][GRID];
    static int[][] A = new int[GRID][GRID];
    static int[][] B = new int[GRID][GRID];
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] graph = new ArrayList[MAXN];
    static ArrayList<Integer>[][] exits = new ArrayList[GRID][GRID];

    static int[] dr = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    static int[] dc = {1, 0, -1, 0};

    static class Hungarian {
        int matchCount;
        int[] matchL = new int[MAXN];
        int[] matchR = new int[MAXN];
        boolean[] seen = new boolean[MAXN];

        int solve(int n, ArrayList<Integer>[] adj) {
            matchCount = 0;
            Arrays.fill(matchL, -1);
            Arrays.fill(matchR, -1);
            for (int u = 0; u < n; ++u) {
                Arrays.fill(seen, false);
                if (dfs(u, adj)) ++matchCount;
            }
            return matchCount;
        }

        private boolean dfs(int u, ArrayList<Integer>[] adj) {
            for (int v : adj[u]) {
                if (seen[v]) continue;
                seen[v] = true;
                if (matchR[v] == -1 || dfs(matchR[v], adj)) {
                    matchL[u] = v;
                    matchR[v] = u;
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }
    }

    static void bfs(int sr, int sc) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < GRID; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < GRID; j++) {
                dist[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        q.add(new int[]{sr, sc});
        dist[sr][sc] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nr = r + dr[i], nc = c + dc[i];
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < GRID && nc >= 0 && nc < GRID &&
                    A[nr][nc] >= 0 && dist[nr][nc] == -1) {
                    dist[nr][nc] = dist[r][c] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nr, nc});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs_propagate(int sr, int sc, int cnt, int T, int[] nodeIdx) {
        int[][] vis = new int[GRID][GRID];
        for (int i = 0; i < GRID; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < GRID; j++) {
                vis[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{sr, sc});
        vis[sr][sc] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
            if (vis[r][c] > Math.min(T, dist[r][c])) continue;
            for (int e : exits[r][c]) {
                for (int k = 0; k < cnt; ++k) {
                    graph[nodeIdx[0] + k].add(e);
                }
            }
            if (vis[r][c] == Math.min(T, dist[r][c])) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nr = r + dr[i], nc = c + dc[i];
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < GRID && nc >= 0 && nc < GRID &&
                    A[nr][nc] >= 0 && vis[nr][nc] == -1) {
                    vis[nr][nc] = vis[r][c] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nr, nc});
                }
            }
        }
        nodeIdx[0] += cnt;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < GRID; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < GRID; j++) {
                A[i][j] = -1;
                B[i][j] = -1;
                exits[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        int sr = -1, sc = -1;

        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String s = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                char c = s.charAt(j-1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) A[i][j] = c - '0';
                if (c == 'Z') { sr = i; sc = j; }
            }
        }

        bfs(sr, sc);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String s = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                char c = s.charAt(j-1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) B[i][j] = c - '0';
                for (int k = 0; k < B[i][j]; ++k) {
                    exits[i][j].add(exits[i][j].size());
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < GRID; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < GRID; ++j)
                if (dist[i][j] == -1) dist[i][j] = INF;

        int[] nodeCount = new int[1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                if (A[i][j] > 0) bfs_propagate(i, j, A[i][j], T, nodeCount);

        Hungarian solver = new Hungarian();
        System.out.println(solver.solve(nodeCount[0], graph));
    }
}
